name: artisans-house-savanna
description: Artisan's House, the savanna look (ROADMAP 49.10g): the shipped Artisan's House drawn again as the savanna village's potter's house: one golden thatch hip over red granite and packed mud with a painted band, the upper storey carried over a shaded stoep on acacia posts, and beside it a mound kiln of red termite-mound earth whose flue spire smokes over the ridge; (II) the journeyman's wing, a drying bench and an open firing pit; (III) the clay cellar. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.
